subject: Signed route to production — marketplace playbook
messages:
From: Maya Patel <m.patel@calyxhealth.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: ProcureOps <procure@calyxhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Nov 2027 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Marketplace private offer — high level MAP and timeline

Hi Naomi,

Thanks for the demo yesterday — the team is excited about Redwood's latency profile and the dedicated GPU option for our inference workloads. Procurement asked me to put together a simple mutual action plan so they can present it to legal and finance. Can you share a one-page MAP + close timeline for the AWS Private Offer route (we'd prefer marketplace flow if possible)?

Key constraints:
- Calyx needs SOC2 evidence and a 12 month data-retention policy in writing
- Billing needs an invoice path; marketplace PO preferred but finance will accept direct invoice if marketplace timing is too long
- We have a compliance review window: Nov 22–26 (US holiday week) — would prefer signed agreement before Dec 5 to hit Jan production activation

Can you include typical milestones, who owns each step (Redwood vs Calyx vs Marketplace), and an expected invoice cadence? Attach whatever templates help.

Thanks,
Maya
Maya Patel
Senior Program Manager, Cloud Deployments
Calyx Health

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Maya Patel <m.patel@calyxhealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Nov 2027 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Marketplace private offer — high level MAP and timeline

Hi Maya — great to hear the team is moving fast.

I've attached an initial MAP workbook (MAP_Calyx-v2.xlsx) and a draft SOW that outlines the activation milestones and acceptance criteria. High level summary below — I'll flag the items that usually drive procurement friction.

High-level milestones (target dates assume signed by Dec 5):
- Week 0 (sign): Redwood issues private-offer terms and DocuSign link; Calyx signs 
- Week 1: Redwood team initiates marketplace private-offer acceptance (AWS) and provisions dedicated pool (staging)
- Week 2: Calyx runs acceptance tests (technical eval) using provided test prompts + perf benchmarks
- Week 3: Acceptance sign-off; finance triggers invoice path (see options below)
- Week 4: Prod rollout and capacity handoff

Common procurement blockers:
- Marketplace private-offer time-to-activation (AWS can take 2–7 business days depending on PO path)
- Invoice routing: marketplace vs direct invoice (we recommend marketplace unless your AP requires Net30 invoice from Redwood)
- SOC2 artifacts: we can provide the SOC2 report and a short controls mapping in two business days once NDA is in place

Billing options we commonly see:
A) Marketplace PO (recommended): Calyx accepts the PO from AWS → AWS invoices Calyx; Redwood receives payout per marketplace schedule. Time-to-activate: typically 2–7 business days after PO submission.
B) Direct invoice to Calyx (expedites payouts): Redwood invoices Calyx directly (Net30). Requires Redwood legal + Calyx AP signoff.
C) Hybrid: marketplace commit with an initial Redwood invoice to speed provisioning, reconciled on marketplace billing.

I'll get Karthik to confirm the billing cadence and Markus to confirm the typical SLA/credit language we recommend for your acceptance gates.

Attaching: MAP_Calyx-v2.xlsx; SOW-draft.pdf

—Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
aomi.feldman@redwood.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Maya Patel <m.patel@calyxhealth.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Nov 2027 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Marketplace private offer — high level MAP and timeline

Maya / Naomi — quick notes on the billing cadence and what to expect from AWS: 

1) Marketplace private-offer acceptance: once Calyx submits the PO in AWS, AWS flags Redwood to accept the offer. Redwood acceptance typically occurs within 1 business day if the PO metadata matches (account ID, order amount).
2) Payout timing: AWS payout cycles can be monthly with a 30–45 day settlement window; if Calyx needs Redwood to invoice directly for an initial commitment we can do that to accelerate cash flow.
3) Invoice estimate: based on the MAP (3 months dev/stage + 9 months prod minimal commit) the initial invoice estimate is attached (invoice_estimate.xlsx).

If Calyx AP needs custom remittance or an internal PO number on the invoice, include that on the PO submission to AWS — that is usually what extends activation time. We can accept an email from ProcureOps with the PO reference and then provision in parallel.

Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Marketplace Partnerships, Redwood Inference

From: ProcureOps <procure@calyxhealth.com>

Thanks for the draft MAP. A couple of clarifying items from Calyx finance:
- Calyx prefers marketplace PO but will accept a short initial Redwood invoice to start staging if that helps provisioning. Can you confirm Redwood's billing entity and W-9 info?
- What is the break in service if acceptance fails to meet the perf criteria in Week 2? We need a clause that maps acceptance failure to a remediation window and an abort path.

We are preparing the PO now — target submission to AWS is Nov 18. Please confirm the DocuSign link for signature and a contact we can call if the marketplace acceptance stalls.

Thanks,
ProcureOps
Calyx Health

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 16 Nov 2027 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Marketplace private offer — high level MAP and timeline

Hi procurement team — answering your points inline: 

- Billing entity / W-9: Redwood Inference, Inc. — W-9 and remittance details are in the Drive link: https://drive.google.com/open?id=MAP-Calyx-v2 (section: billing).
- Acceptance failure: our standard remediation window is 10 business days from failure detection. During that window we will prioritize fixes and provide a remediation report; if acceptance is not achieved after remediation, either party can exit the MAP with a pro-rated refund for unused dedicated capacity. We will add the exact language to the SOW.

If you submit the PO on Nov 18 we can accept the private-offer and provision staging by Nov 22. If by any chance AWS acceptance stalls, Naomi (naomi.feldman@redwood.com) and I (markus.klein@redwood.com) are the escalation contacts — we will also open a support ticket with AWS on your behalf.

Markus
Markus Klein
Director, Solutions Engineering (Redwood Dedicated)
